title: 職業指導
subtitle: Career Guidance
courseType:
Teacher Certification Program
Teacher Certification Courses
educationalGoal: Now in the situation of education, vocational guidance (career guidance) is changing to foster in students a zest for life. In this course, we understand the history of vocational guidance, the current situation around the school, and the trends in educational reformation. Then we will consider how students will select and determine their own way of life, and the way of vocational guidance (career guidance) that allows them to achieve self-actualization.
advice: This course is divided into two parts as below. Part 1: historical and theoretical considerations 1. The change of society and the current situation around students 2. The history of vocational guidance(career guidance) 3. Curriculum and vocational guidance(career guidance) 4. The basic theory of vocational guidance 5. The current situation of vocational guidance(career guidance) Part 2: Practical consideration 1. The concept and practice of vocational guidance(career guidance) 2. The educational evaluation of vocational guidance(career guidance) 3. The collaborative design of vocational guidance(career guidance) 4. Exercise: making an annual guidance plan
books: Koizumi, Reiji., Furukawa, Masahumi., and Nishiyama, Hisako.(2016) Keyword of Career Education: the Significance and Practice of Lifespan Education of Career Design Education. Kitaouji-Shobou.
requiredKnowledge: To be interested in the current situation of education and school.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain curriculum and vocational guidance(career guidance).
Be able to explain the significance of vocational guidance(career guidance).
Be able to make an annual plan for vocational guidance based on the theory of vocational guidance.
Be able to engage in this course and self-evaluate objectives of this course to be achieved.

achievementLevels.ideal: 1) Explain the relationship between curriculum and vocational guidance(career guidance) deeply. 2) Describe opinions about vocational guidance(career guidance) from various perspectives. 3) Envisage vocational guidance practice at school and make an annual plan for vocational guidance(career guidance)

lessons.assignments: ●Review the discussion and make an opinion.

lessons.content: ■Social change and today's situation of students ・the current situation of elementary school pupil and high school student ・the current situation of employment and labor ■Self-reflection
lessons.assignments: ●Read hand-out and understand the current situation of elementary school pupil and high school student.
●Review the content of the class, consider own view of occupation ●Review the discussion and make an opinion.

lessons.content: ■Career education: vocational guidance, career guidance, and career education ■Self-reflection
lessons.assignments: ●Read hand-out and understand the concept of vocational guidance, career guidance, and career education.

lessons.content: ■History of vocational guidance (career guidance): the history of vocational guidance (career guidance, career education) in USA and Japan ■Self-reflection
lessons.assignments: ●Understand the establishment and development of vocational guidance (career guidance, career education) in USA and Japan.

lessons.content: ■Vocational guidance (career guidance) in the Course of Study in high school: its position and issues ■Self-reflection
lessons.assignments: ●Review the discussion and make an opinion. ●Understand the position of vocational guidance (career guidance, career education).

lessons.content: ■Theory of vocational guidance (career guidance) ・trait and factor theory ・vocational personality theory ・vocational development theory ・self-realization theory ■Self-reflection
lessons.assignments: ●Read the chapter on theory of vocational guidance. ●Summarize the lecture.

lessons.content: ■Quiz ■Vocational guidance (career guidance) in senior high school: technical high school ■Self-reflection
lessons.assignments: ●Summarize 1-7 classes ●Read hand-out and consider the current situation of vocational guidance in high school.

lessons.content: ■Concept of vocational design (career guidance) (1) ・traits and career information ・experiences for enlightenment ・career counseling ■Self-reflection
lessons.assignments: ●Understand the significance and of implementation points for career counseling. ●Review the discussion and make an opinion.

lessons.content: ■Concept of vocational design (career guidance) (2) ・follow-up guidance ・evaluation of vocational guidance (career guidance) ■Self-reflection
lessons.assignments: ●Understand the significance and of implementation points for follow-up guidance. ●Complete the worksheet

lessons.content: ●Cooperative design of vocational guidance (career guidance): cooperation between school, home, and community ●Self-reflection
lessons.assignments: ●Consider the significance of "Period for Integrated Studies"

lessons.content: ●Design and practice of vocational design (career guidance) (1): creating a career plan that takes into account personality, aptitude, and occupational surveys ●Self-reflection
●Design and practice of vocational design (career guidance) (2): preparation for entrance examination and after the examination ●Self-reflection
●Design and practice of vocational design (career guidance) (3): From job offer to joining the company and manners as a member of society ●Self-reflection

lessons.assignments: ●Review all classes. ●Reflect the whole this course.
